title: New, seen and read
changes: An article counts as seen once it has been on screen in your feed, or once you open it. It stays bold until you next open the app, so nothing changes in front of you.
A "Mark all as seen" button at the top of the feed catches you up on everything, a folder, a source or a person, without calling those articles read. Undo is offered.
The feed tells three states apart: new is bold, seen is plain, read is plain with a ✓ Read mark. The Read tab still lists only what you actually read.
Marking an article unread makes it new again.

title: Mentions you can tap, and pictures in feedback
changes: Replies from the agent that answers feedback now show as "einkReader agent".
@mentions in feedback show as outlined chips; tap one to open that person's profile.
Several pictures in a note sit side by side in a row you scroll sideways. In the viewer, swipe, tap the arrows or press the left/right arrow keys to go through them.
New feedback can include as many pictures as you like from your device.
A reply you haven't sent is kept for each thread and comes back when you return, even after closing the app.

title: Lighter storage, and feedback on any Nostr app
changes: Pictures download when you open an article or put it in To read (Inbox articles get theirs right away), instead of for every article at each refresh.
Once a day, pictures are removed from articles that aren't in To read or the Inbox, read, favorited or highlighted; opening one brings them back.
A feedback thread opens in your Nostr app (Primal, Amethyst…) from the new button at its top right, to reply or react there. New feedback carries #einkreader, so any Nostr app can follow it.
einkreader.app links to einkreader on Nostr in its footer, and each feedback thread on the site opens in any Nostr app.

title: einkreader is on Google Play
changes: einkreader.app now links to the app on Google Play. Signed APKs stay available from the open source page.

title: The article menu opens below the top bar
changes: The article menu opens below the top bar, so its ⋮ button stays visible, and "Reload & reprocess" is now simply "Reload".

title: Article menu, feedback tags, and pages that keep headings with their text
changes: The article's buttons are now in one menu at the top right: text size (A− and A+ keep the menu open), Share, Reload & reprocess, and a new Send feedback.
When writing feedback, tag it as Bug, Feature request or Rendering issue in one tap. The feedback list offers the same tags as filters.
New feedback is now at the top right of the Feedback screen. The list fetches what's new by itself, so the refresh button is gone.
Turning pages: a heading is never left alone at the bottom of a page, and a paragraph never leaves just its first line behind.
Posts embedded in Substack articles show as a quote with a link to the post, instead of loose lines and a broken link.

title: Pages that end on a whole line
changes: Turning pages: each page ends after a whole line, never through one, and at the end of a paragraph when it can.
A feed served broken partway (as Daring Fireball's once was) keeps the posts before the break instead of failing the whole refresh.
Pages a site refuses to send to the app (bot checks, 403, 404) keep the feed's summary with a note to open them in the browser, instead of being retried on every refresh.

title: Who reacted, @mentions, and the right link for linked posts
changes: In Feedback, a long press on a reaction shows who reacted and when.
Type @ in a reply to mention someone: people in the thread are suggested first. Mentions show as names that open the profile, and notify the person on any Nostr app.
Linked posts from blogs like Daring Fireball are shared, copied and opened as the blog's own post, not the page they link to. You still read the linked page with the blog's comment on top.

title: Rename your sources
changes: Any source can be renamed from its ⋮ menu in Sources. The new name stays, even when the feed refreshes.

feedback.title: Add ability to edit feed name

title: Saturday morning digests
changes: Email digests arrive on Saturday at 7am in your own time zone, only in weeks with new highlights.
Subscriber email addresses are stored encrypted.
Public pages and digests show when each highlight was shared, above its title, so it isn't confused with the article's own date. Digests include the author's bio.
Public pages list every link on the author's profile, not only the first (an x.com profile, for instance).

title: A note with your highlights
changes: Sharing all of an article's highlights at once takes an optional note about them together: it leads the tweet and email, and appears with the story on your public page.
The share window shows your public page's address next to "Your profile".
The share window remembers which channels you used last time (your profile, Twitter).

title: Public pages by month
changes: Public pages group stories under a header per month, with a link to the month before. Each month has its own address (einkreader.app/name/2026/9), and each year a page listing its months (einkreader.app/name/2025).
Dates above each story are just the date, without "Shared".
A Subscribe button in the page header jumps to the subscription options.

title: Lighter avatar picking
changes: Choosing a profile photo no longer loads the full-resolution image twice, which could run low-memory e-ink devices out of memory.

title: Suggested reads from around the world
changes: "Start with suggested reads" opens a picker of 40 or so feeds: essays and long reads for everyone, plus picks for your language or country (French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, the UK, North America, South Asia, East Asia, Africa, Australia). Your own region comes first and is pre-selected.

title: About & contact, suggested reads
changes: Settings → About & contact: our email address, the website, the privacy policy and the changelog.
A fresh install can start with a few suggested reads (Aeon, Hacker News, The Marginalian) in one tap, instead of an empty screen.

title: Instant search, a cleaner profile editor
changes: Search uses a full-text index, so results come back almost instantly however big your library is. Accents don't matter ("etudiants" finds "Étudiants"), and words match by their beginning.
Opening your profile no longer flashes "Create a profile" first.
The profile editor drops its welcome box and the repeated address box.

title: Faster public pages and a weekly email digest
changes: Public profile pages load in a fraction of a second instead of about five, and update within seconds of a new highlight.
Following someone by email now asks you to confirm your address, and every digest has a one-click unsubscribe link.
The email form on profile pages fits phone screens and no longer zooms the page when you type.

title: Quote posts on X, or a screenshot when you can't
changes: Sharing a post to X quotes it. If X refuses the quote because its author limits who can quote it, the post goes out with a screenshot of the original attached instead (reconnect X once to allow image uploads).
The debug log shows the date stored for each new X bookmark.

title: Every article in its source's list, faster search
changes: The home screen lists every article instead of only the 500 most recent.
Search is faster and shows each result's date.
Posts X refuses for good, like duplicates, wait in the outbox with the reason instead of being retried at every sync.

title: Forwarded newsletters stay readable
changes: Substack newsletters forwarded or sent to your @einkreader.app address keep their whole text, with their title, byline and images, instead of being replaced by the publication's subscribe page.
Pictures that link to a larger version show as pictures, not as a stray "!".

title: Author profiles on the web
changes: On the web feedback page, an author's name or avatar opens their profile.

title: Reading settings: font, margins and page turns
changes: New Reading section in Settings, with a live preview: text size, margins, and four fonts (Serif, Literata, Sans-serif, Atkinson Hyperlegible).
Turn pages instead of scrolling: articles move a screen at a time, with "← Page 2 / 5 →" at the bottom. Swipes and page keys turn pages too.
The text size is now remembered.

title: Know when someone answers your feedback
changes: The feedback icon shows how many new replies and reactions your feedback got; threads with news are marked "new".
Feedback is now readable on the web at einkreader.app/feedback, and there is a contact page.

title: Backups that don't freeze the app
changes: Backing up a large library no longer makes the app unresponsive; a progress bar shows how far along it is.
Settings show when your last backup was made, and how big it was.

title: Ready for the Play Store
changes: The Play Store version is signed for release.
Tidier website addresses: /privacy, /opensource, /brand.

title: X sign-in built into the Play Store version
changes: The Play Store version connects to X (Twitter) without needing your own developer key.

title: Feedback loads by itself
changes: The feedback list loads and refreshes on its own.
Screenshots are attached to article feedback only when you ask, and open full screen.
A more compact Inbox, with an "Other senders" filter.

title: Account deletion
changes: You can delete your profile and your @einkreader.app address, from the app or the website.
Fixed sharing by email.

title: Faster feedback, simpler setup
changes: Feedback opens instantly from what's saved on your device.
Adding a source starts by picking its type: RSS, X or Nostr.
Creating a profile starts with your address, checked as you type.
Inbox comes first in the filters and in your sources.

title: Instant feedback posting
changes: Posting feedback is instant; offline, it waits in the outbox.
A more compact feedback list.
Tapping a name opens a fuller profile with their highlights and feedback.

title: A quieter feedback link
changes: The feedback button under articles became a discreet line of text.
A simpler feedback form that shows clearly who you post as.

title: The Inbox
changes: Links, newsletters and PDFs emailed to your @einkreader.app address land in a new Inbox, filtered by sender.
Mail from new senders waits for you to accept it.

title: Feedback with screenshots
changes: Send feedback with a subject, a link and a screenshot, right from any article.
